subject: Re: Kickoff: city relighting track (May-Aug)
body:
Dmitri — staffing and infra for the relighting track.

Allocations: Carmen 50% throughout; Wanjiru 40% May-June rising to 60% in July for the demo push; Chiara 30%; Bilal 30% from June. And Oyin Iversen is committed at 60% to this project for July 2026 — she's the only person here who has run the alignment optimization at scale, so the July demo critically depends on that allocation holding.

Compute is light: decomposition and alignment fit on 8-16 A100s best-effort on titan. Storage: 12TB for panorama stacks.

One dependency — our own capture stacks come through Corpus ingestion, and with the v2 migration freeze on 2026-07-10 I want our stack imports done by early July so we're not importing during the freeze.

Daniela
